subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into segments. One of them may contain an error. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

Among you and me / she is quite rude / to the boy.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Among you and me'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The erroneous part of the given sentence is **among you and me. **
 
• **"Among" **is used when referring to more than two people or things - *students chatting **among **themselves*
 
• But in the case of the given sentence **two people **are referred to - *you and me. *
 
• Hence, **option 1** is the correct answer. 
 
• To make the sentence correct we need to use **between.**

***Correct sentence - ******Between you and me **/ she is quite rude / to the boy.*
